children: RNS Number : 1966W  Hollywood Bowl Group plc  25 September 2026
25 September 2026
Hollywood Bowl Group plc
(the "Company")
Directorate Change

Hollywood Bowl Group, operator of the UK's and Canada's largest ten-pin bowling brands, is pleased to announce that Simon Dodd will be appointed as an independent Non-Executive Director of the Company, and as a member of the Audit and Remuneration Committees, effective 1 November 2026.

Simon has more than 20 years' experience in senior operational, marketing, and commercial roles across the pub and brewing sector. He is currently Chief Executive of Young & Co.'s Brewery plc, a role he has held since 2022.

Simon was previously Chief Operating Officer of Young's, responsible for the Group's managed house operations, including marketing. Before joining Young's, he was an Executive Director at Fuller, Smith & Turner plc, and Managing Director of its beer company, having earlier served as Operations Director of its City pubs division. Prior to Fuller's, Simon was Chief Operating Officer and Commercial Director at Orchid Pub Company.
Darren Shapland, Chair of the Company, said:

"We are delighted to welcome Simon to the Board. His extensive hospitality leadership and operational experience will further strengthen the Board and provide valuable insight as we continue to support the Group's ambitious growth plans."
Other than as set out above, there are no matters to declare under paragraph 6.4.8R of the UK Listing Rules.
